title: Extract project management functionality to standalone CLI package
description: Create a new standalone package contrib/project-manager that extracts the project management functionality from pkg/tools/project as a CLI application using urfave/cli/v2. The package must be self-contained with no external dependencies to the main agents module.

title: Implement CLI commands for dependency management
description: Create CLI commands for task dependency management: add dependencies, remove dependencies, list dependencies. Include visualization of dependency chains.

title: Add configuration and database setup
description: Implement configuration management for database connections, CLI settings, and default values. Support both inmemory and postgres backends with proper connection handling.

title: Add comprehensive testing
description: Create unit tests and integration tests for the CLI application. Test all commands, repository implementations, and core business logic to ensure functionality works correctly.

title: Create documentation and README
description: Create comprehensive documentation including README.md with installation instructions, usage examples, and command reference. Document the CLI interface and provide getting started guide.

title: Analyze dependencies and create dependency map
description: Analyze all dependencies in pkg/tools/project and pkg/shared to understand what needs to be copied to make the new package self-contained. Create a comprehensive list of all files and dependencies that need to be included.

title: Create basic project structure for contrib/project-manager
description: Set up the basic directory structure, go.mod file, and main.go entry point for the new CLI application using urfave/cli/v2. Include proper module naming and basic CLI framework setup.

title: Copy and adapt core project management types and interfaces
description: Copy all necessary types, interfaces, and shared structures from pkg/tools/project/shared and adapt them for the standalone package. Remove any dependencies on external agent frameworks.

title: Copy repository implementations (inmemory and postgres)
description: Copy the repository implementations from pkg/tools/project/repository/inmemory and postgres, adapting them to work without external dependencies. Ensure database operations work independently.

title: Copy and adapt project manager and service logic
description: Copy the core business logic from manager.go, service.go, and related files. Remove tool-related functionality and adapt for CLI usage. Maintain all project and task management capabilities.

title: Copy required shared dependencies
description: Copy necessary parts from pkg/shared (types, utilities) and other internal dependencies that are required for the project management functionality to work independently.

title: Implement CLI commands for project operations
description: Create CLI commands for project operations: create, list, get, update, delete projects. Use urfave/cli/v2 framework with proper command structure and help text.

title: Implement CLI commands for task operations
description: Create CLI commands for task operations: create, list, get, update, delete tasks. Include task hierarchy management, state changes, and complexity handling. Provide clear output formatting.
